title: AI/ML Engineer Assessment Prep
description: From ML and transformer basics to advanced LLM engineering: inference and memory math, fine-tuning, RAG, eval statistics, agents, decoding, system design, four hard coding problems plus 22 patterns with tested Python, 12 extra deep-dive parts (classical ML, maths, deep learning, NLP, LLM architectures, alignment, MLOps, vision, recommenders, reinforcement learning, statistics, LLM applications), a 329-question interview bank, a 60-question quiz and a printable cheat sheet.

title: DSA Master Guide (Python)
description: Data structures and algorithms from zero, for coding rounds: 56 topics in 18 modules with interactive animations, dry-run tables and tested Python, 255 practice problems with hints and verified solutions, 30 patterns, LeetCode-style classics, 7 advanced parts (Fenwick and segment trees, shortest paths, flows, advanced DP, string algorithms, number theory, complexity theory, 20 extra problems), a 1,200-question interview bank, a 112-question assessment and a printable cheat sheet.

title: Diffusion Models from Scratch
description: Build your own image diffusion model with PyTorch on a 4GB GPU, assuming only Python: setup, a package reference, the full theory with worked numbers, every file of a working model, upgrades (EMA, cosine schedule, DDIM, classifier-free guidance), 7 deep-dive parts (math, samplers, latent diffusion, control, evaluation, other modalities, training at scale), a 123-question interview bank, a 34-question quiz and a cheat sheet.

title: System Design Guide
description: System design from scratch to advanced: interview framework, estimation, networking, load balancing, databases, replication and sharding, consistency and consensus, caching, messaging, APIs, reliability, security and operations, search and big data, 10 advanced parts (storage engines, event-driven design, data processing, cloud, security, ML systems), 31 worked system designs, 5 low-level designs, trade-off and mock-interview guides, a glossary, tested code, a 311-question interview bank, a quiz and a cheat sheet.

title: Python and SQL Guide
description: Python and SQL from scratch to advanced, and together: language basics, data structures, OOP, generators and decorators, concurrency, testing and packaging; SQL queries, joins, windows, recursion, design, transactions and performance; DB-API, ORMs, pipelines, more than 320 executed examples, the standard library, data formats and HTTP, Python internals, design patterns, SQL dialects and NoSQL, analytics SQL, transactions in depth, 46 SQL problems, projects, a 265-question interview bank and a cheat sheet.
